name: cauce
description: One core for Claude Code: routes each task to the right model, effort and capabilities, escalates on evidence, and remembers what failed across repositories.

livespec.title: livespec code index
livespec.description: Use livespec throughout the flow: index the repository, route on what the index shows, brief every worker with a code map, give workers livespec's tools, and report what a change touched. On by default; runs the pinned release through uvx when livespec is not installed.
